definition: Techniques for reducing the length of a prompt while preserving the information necessary for a model to perform a task correctly.
details: Prompt compression helps manage cost and latency in LLM applications, especially those involving long documents or extensive conversation history, by removing redundant or low-information content before it reaches the model.
story: Picture a novelist who has read so much that, given a first line, they cannot help but write the next one. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. The result feels creative because it is memory, reshuffled at speed. It is prediction pushed forward — each next word, or pixel, guessed from everything that came before it. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Prompt Compression.
